name: Dades Valley: the Monkey Fingers
why: Into a maze of narrow red canyons whose rounded rock pillars look like knuckles, then back through almond orchards and kasbahs of the Dades.
book: Free; a local guide helps you find the way out of the canyons.
dangers: Short scrambles and a ladder in the narrows.
Heat from June to September: walk early, carry 2-3 litres.

points.name: Tamellalt
points.note: A village in the valley under the rock formations.

points.name: Monkey Fingers
points.note: Red conglomerate pillars shaped like fingers.
